fig1_work_energy_theorem.svg: For a mass pushed from rest by a constant force, the work computed by the module's line-integral work() (orange) matches the kinetic energy from kinetic_energy() (dashed) at every displacement: W = Delta T, the work-energy theorem.
fig2_work_force_law.svg: Work accumulated by work() along a straight push for two force laws. A constant force gives work growing linearly with distance (W=2x); a force that grows with position (F=2x) gives quadratic work (W=x^2) -- work is the area under F vs x.
